file_metadata.scope: Physical choreography of all services: doors, curtain, censing, vestments, bows, hand positions, clergy movement
file_metadata.description: Machine-queryable encoding of the Ordo's General Rules (§1–§28) and per-service door/curtain state protocols. Each rule cites its Ordo §-number. Supersedes all prior Dolnytsky Part I references.

§1.rule: Sanctuary at least one step higher than nave. No steps within sanctuary to Holy Table.

§2.rule: Holy Table is square, detached from wall, centered. Prothesis table on north wall, vestment table on south wall.

§3.rule: Artophorion (tabernacle) centered on Holy Table, shaped like small church or sepulcher. Must not obstruct celebrant or concelebrants.

§4.rule: Candelabra on Holy Table must not overcrowd it. One candelabrum (1-3 candles) per side of cross or artophorion. Seven-branched oil candelabrum placed behind Holy Table.

§5.rule: No reliquaries, flowers, or unnecessary items on Holy Table. Service book on pillow upon Holy Table, or on analogion to left side.

§6.rule: Iconostasis: Savior icon to right of central doors, Theotokos to left. Parecclesiae need own iconostasis; Holy Table without iconostasis is unsuitable.

§7.rule: Only priests, deacons, clerics, and servers may enter Altar. No laity, especially women, regardless of status.

§8.rule: Diskarion (paten) must be large, with rim; may have stem-base.

§9.rule: Thurible has short chains for full-length swing.

§10.rule: No vestments or linens beyond those prescribed. No bells, organs, or harmoniums.

small_bow.description: Incline head and shoulders while making sign of Cross. Do NOT extend hand to knees or ground.

single.note: At 'Blessed is our God' or 'Through the prayers'
When coming before doors for reading/chanting

triple.note: Once per each threefold Alleluia (3x total)

exceptions.gospel_begin_end: Sign of Cross WITHOUT inclining head/shoulders
exceptions.deacon_to_priest: Deacon inclines head/shoulders to priest before leaving Altar for ektenies and when returning

great_bow_prostration.description: Sign of Cross then prostrate entire body to ground.

elevated_hands.description: Hands extended and elevated. Elbows must NOT touch sides; hands freely extended on high.

default_positions.description: When no posture prescribed, hands may be: on Holy Table, holding service book, under phelonion, or crossed on breast. NEVER joined finger-to-finger.

deacon_orarion.rule: While reciting ektenies, deacon raises orarion with three fingers of right hand. Priest may begin reading silent prayer as soon as deacon begins petitions.

head_bowing.rule: At 'Bow your heads to the Lord' — all incline head and shoulders.

kneeling.rule: Servers do NOT kneel in Altar during Divine Liturgy. People may kneel if they desire.

priestly_blessing_hand.rule: Thumb of right hand over ring finger, index finger extended, middle and little fingers slightly bent. Recipients bow head/shoulders and sign themselves with Cross.

doors_and_curtain.description: General rules for opening/closing royal doors and veil (curtain).

side_doors.rule: Always closed unless someone must pass through.

transitions.note: Opened for Entrance at 'Glory' of Stichera
Closed after Prokeimenon or Old Testament readings
Opened for Dismissal after Troparia
Closed after Dismissal when clergy return to Altar
Opened when priest censes at beginning
Closed when Psalm 103 begins

divine_liturgy.note: In some places, custom to open/close more often.

transitions.note: Opened for Typika dismissal before Presanctified
Closed after Typika dismissal
Opened for Entrance at 'Glory, Both now' of Lord I Call
Remains open during 'The Light of Christ illumines all'
Closed for reading of second Paremia
Opened if feast day has Epistle and Gospel
Closed after Holy Gospel on feast day
Opened for Great Entrance during 'Now the Powers of Heaven'
Closed immediately following Great Entrance
Opened after clergy communion for faithful communion
Closed after final dismissal

bright_week.rule: Royal doors AND side doors remain open during entire Bright Week, even during Communion of celebrant.

hierarchical_service.rule: Royal doors always remain open while a bishop celebrates.

curtain_veil.vespers_and_orthros: Open throughout all of Vespers and Orthros.

transitions.note: Remains open from beginning of Presanctified through the Great Entrance
Drawn shut immediately after Great Entrance
Drawn open before the communion of the faithful
Remains open through the dismissal and conclusion

regional_variation.note: Some regions keep royal doors and veil open from beginning to end of Chrysostom/Basil Liturgy. At Presanctified, after 'Let my prayer arise' doors/veil are not closed after Entrance. This practice is NOT to be extended to other regions.

§20.incense_loading: Server or deacon loads thurible and presents to priest for blessing. Priest is NOT the only one who loads incense.
§20.sign_of_cross: Laudable for priest/deacon to make sign of Cross with thurible before censing.
§20.reverence: When censing any person or object, slightly incline head and shoulders.

§21.first_blessing: First incense blessing in any service: 'We offer incense to You...'
§21.subsequent: All other times in same service: 'Blessed is our God...'

§22.rule: When vesting for any service, vestments are blessed and kissed as at Prothesis (§103-106). Same procedure for other services but prayers omitted.

§23.rule: Priest not wearing sticharion should wear rason (Greek: rason / Slavonic: riasa) over cassock.

§24.rule: No one may wear vestment proper to an Order superior to his own.

daily_vespers_matins.note: Over rason/cassock. Phelonion added at Entrance and other prescribed moments.

vigil_vespers.note: Phelonion blessed and kissed before Entrance.

divine_liturgy_full.note: Per Ordo §103–106. Epigonation on right thigh if entitled.

presanctified_communion.note: Orarion bound crosswise at Communion per §244.

§25.one_deacon: Stands at priest's right unless otherwise prescribed.
§25.two_deacons: First deacon at priest's right, second at priest's left.

§26.rule: Only ordained deacons may function in the office of a deacon.

concelebration_voice.rule: Raised-voice phrases by priest/deacon are NOT recited in subdued voice by other concelebrants, except ekphoneses concluding prayers and unless otherwise prescribed.

variant_system.rule: Complete ceremonies explained in section with one deacon. Other sections (two deacons, without deacon, concelebrants) explain only what differs.

variants.label: With the Ministry of One Deacon
With the Ministry of Two Deacons
Without the Ministry of a Deacon

sequence.note: Beginning with Savior icon, via north door
From soleas or by processing down nave
Via south door, censes Holy Table front and celebrant
One from right, other from left

let_my_prayer_arise.description: Priest censes the four sides of the Holy Table with three swings at each verse, preceded by deacon with lighted candle

sequence.verse: Let my prayer be set forth
Let my prayer be set forth (conclusion)

paschal_matins_opening.description: Solemn Paschal censing by celebrant with cross and censer, preceded by deacon with lighted candle

polyeleos_magnification.description: Solemn censing during the Polyeleos Magnification before the tetrapod

§29.deacon: Holds sticharion and orarion, approaches priest, head bowed: 'Master, bless.' Priest blesses: 'Blessed is our God.' Deacon: 'Amen.' Dons sticharion, kisses orarion, places on left shoulder.

§30.priest: Already wearing rason. Blesses epitrachelion, puts it on. Exits via north door, stands before closed royal doors. Small bow. 'Blessed is our God.' After Our Father: 'For Thine is the kingdom.'

§31.priest: Quietly reads all Prayers of Light before royal doors.
§31.deacon: After Psalm, exits via north door, small bow to priest, begins Great Synapte.
§31.after_ekphonesis: Deacon makes small bow, returns via south door, stands at priest's right.

§32.deacon: Exits via north door, says Small Synapte. After ekphonesis, small bow, returns to Altar.

§33.deacon: Takes thurible, presents to priest for blessing. Full censing: Holy Table (4 sides), apsidal icon, altar icons, priest. Exits via north door, censes iconostasis (south from Savior, north from Theotokos), choirs, people from soleas. Returns via south door.

§34.priest: Blesses and kisses phelonion, vests. At Glory, priest and deacon come before Holy Table. Royal doors opened. Deacon takes thurible, receives blessing. Preceded by candlebearers, they go around Holy Table from right, exit via north door. Stand before royal doors. Deacon says 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Priest says Prayer of Entrance. Deacon points orarion east: 'Master, bless the holy entrance.' Priest blesses: 'Blessed is the entrance.' Deacon makes sign of Cross with thurible or elevates Gospel, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!' They enter Altar. Deacon censes as at §33.

§35.deacon: Comes to royal doors: 'Let us be attentive!' Priest blesses: 'Peace be with all.' Deacon: 'Wisdom! Be attentive!' After prokeimenon and lessons, priest returns to Holy Table. Deacon walks around table, exits via north door, says ektene 'Let us all say' and aitisis 'Let us complete.' After ekphonesis, deacon returns via south door.

§36.note: After troparia, royal doors opened. Deacon exits via south door, stands near Savior icon, elevates orarion: 'Wisdom!' Priest says Dismissal from center of royal doors. Then returns through royal doors; deacon via south door. Royal doors closed. Small bow before Holy Table. Unvest.

§37.deacon: First deacon departs via north door, says Great Synapte. Second deacon remains inside Altar.

§38.deacon: Second deacon departs via north door, says Small Synapte. Returns to Altar via south door.

§39.deacon: Both deacons take thuribles. Coordinated censing per §39: cense Holy Table (both front/back, first deacon right, second deacon left), icons, priest. First deacon censes south iconostasis and right choir, second deacon censes north iconostasis and left choir. Both cense people from soleas.

§40.deacon: At Entrance, exit order: candlebearers, second deacon, first deacon, priest. First deacon says 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Priest says Entrance Prayer. First deacon asks blessing. Exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!'

§41.deacon: Deacons show reverence to priest, leave Altar: second deacon via north door, first deacon via south door. Litanies: first deacon says ektene, second deacon says aitisis.

§42.deacon: Royal doors opened. Deacons leave via own doors, stand before royal doors facing one another. First deacon (near Savior icon) raises orarion: 'Wisdom!' Both keep oraria raised during Dismissal. Enter Altar via own doors. Royal doors closed.

two_deacons.note: Litanies distributed: 1st deacon = Great Synapte + ektene, 2nd deacon = Small Synapte + aitisis. Censing coordinated per §39. At Entrance, exit order: 2nd deacon, then 1st deacon, then priest. At Dismissal, both keep oraria raised.

§43.rule: Priest performs all diaconal parts EXCEPT: 'Let us pray to the Lord' and 'Master, bless.'

§44.priest: Says before royal doors. After ekphonesis, returns to Altar via south door.

§45.priest: Says Small Synapte. At 'Lord, I have cried' censes as §33. Enters Altar via south door.

§46.priest: Takes thurible or Gospel. Goes around Holy Table from right, exits via north door. Bows before royal doors. Says Entrance Prayer. Blesses entrance with right hand, kisses Gospel. Makes sign of Cross with thurible or elevates Gospel: 'Wisdom! Stand aright!' Enters Altar through royal doors.

§47.priest: Comes to royal doors: 'Let us be attentive!' Blesses: 'Peace be with all.' 'Wisdom! Be attentive!' For lessons, turns to Holy Table and exclaims from behind it.

§48.priest: Returns to Holy Table. Says ektene and aitisis there.

§49.priest: Faces people. 'Wisdom!' Says Dismissal from royal doors.

§50.rule: Concelebrants (usually even number) vest in epitrachelion and phelonion over rason just before Entrance. Stand at sides of Holy Table, NOT in front. Order: 1st to right, 2nd to left, 3rd to right, etc.

§51.rule: All make small bow. Phelonia hanging freely, hands lowered. Younger priests precede. Exit via north door. Stand in double file at royal doors. Principal celebrant in center behind. Only principal says Entrance Prayer.

§52.rule: 'For You are merciful' by principal. 'For You, O God, are gracious' may be by 1st concelebrant. 'May the might of Your kingdom' by principal.

vigil_choreography._source: Ordo §53–§73 (Section III: Vespers With All-Night Vigil)
vigil_choreography.note: Follows Vespers Without Vigil pattern with additions: opening censing with 'Command!', Litiya procession to narthex, Artoklasia (5 loaves blessing), transition to Orthros.

one_deacon_key_additions.§54: Priest opens royal doors. Deacon exits via north door with candle: 'Command!' Returns. Priest censes (full). 'Bless, O Lord.' Enter Altar. 'Glory to the Holy Trinity.' Psalm 103.
one_deacon_key_additions.§57: Litiya: Priest with hand cross + deacon with thurible exit to narthex. Stichera, petitions, blessing of loaves.
one_deacon_key_additions.§60: Transition to Orthros: Priest closes doors, removes phelonion. Six Psalms begin.

§59.two_deacons: Both deacons exit via northern door carrying thuribles, preceding the concelebrating priests. First deacon censes the tetrapod and the icons.
§59.one_deacon: Deacon carrying thurible exits via northern door, preceding the priest, and censes the tetrapod.
§59.without_deacon: Priest carrying hand cross and censer exits via Holy Doors, precedes to the narthex.

§61.with_deacon: First deacon raises orarion with three fingers of right hand and exclaims the Litiya petitions: 'O God, save Your people...'
§61.without_deacon: Priest exclaims the Litiya petitions from the soleas or narthex.

§63.rule: Priest censes the five loaves, wheat, wine, and oil in the form of a cross (three times), then reads the prayer of blessing.

orthros_choreography.note: Complete ministerial distributions across one deacon, two deacons, without deacon, and concelebration.

key_moments.§76: Six Psalms: Priest reads Orthros prayers at Holy Table. After first 3 psalms, exits via north door to read before royal doors.
key_moments.§78: Prokeimenon: Royal doors opened. Priest vests in phelonion. Deacon censes Holy Table (4 sides) and rest per §33.
key_moments.§79: Gospel: Priest takes Gospel through royal doors, stands on soleas, reads facing people on analogion.
key_moments.§80: Anointing (Vigil only): Priest with hand cross exits through royal doors. Deacon takes blessed oil and quill, exits via north door. Priest anoints foreheads at tetrapod.
key_moments.§82: Great Doxology: Royal doors opened. Priest in phelonion before altar.

§76.concelebration: Clergy exit the Altar through the Holy Doors. Concelebrating priests precede in reverse order of dignity (younger first), followed by the principal celebrant, and stand around the tetrapod.
§76.single_priest: Priest exits the Altar through the Holy Doors and stands before the tetrapod in the center of the nave.

§79.with_deacon: Deacon censes the Holy Table on all four sides, the Altar, the iconostasis, the priest, and the people.
§79.without_deacon: Priest censes the Holy Table on all four sides, the iconostasis, and the people.

§75.instruction: Priest in epitrachelion exits north door, exclaims 'Blessed is our God', Trisagion, enters Altar, censes Holy Table (4 sides) and entire church; deacon assists.

§76.deacon: At end of Six Psalms, deacon exits north door, small bow to priest, exclaims Great Synapte. Recites verses during 'God is the Lord', returns to Altar via south door.

§77.deacon: Deacon exclaims Small Synapte before royal doors after each regular Kathisma, returns via south door.

§78.deacon: Royal doors opened. Deacon: 'Let us be attentive!' Priest blesses. Deacon: 'Wisdom! Let us be attentive!' Choir sings Prokeimenon. Deacon: 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Priest: 'For Holy are You...' Deacon censes 4 sides of altar and sanctuary. Deacon recites verses at 'Let everything that has breath'. Deacon: 'And that we may be vouchsafed...' Priest reads Matins Gospel on analogion on soleas.

§79.deacon: Priest carries Gospel to tetrapod, returns through royal doors. Deacon chants 'Having beheld the Resurrection' (or Reader Ps 50) and 'O God, save Your people'.

§80.deacon: If Vigil, priest with cross exits holy doors, deacon with holy oil exits north door. Priest anoints foreheads at tetrapod; return through royal/south doors.

§81.deacon: Deacon sings Small Litany after Odes 3 and 6. After Ode 8 Katavasia, deacon stands before Theotokos icon: 'The Theotokos and Mother of Light let us magnify in songs!', censes altar and entire church. Chants Small Litany after Ode 9.

§82.deacon: At Glory of Praises, deacon opens royal doors. Priest exclaims 'Glory to You Who have shown us the Light.' Following Great Doxology, priest preceded by deacon carries Gospel back to Holy Table.

§83.deacon: Deacon chants litanies 'Have mercy on us' and 'Let us complete'. Priest gives Dismissal; deacon starts 'Wisdom!'

§85.deacon: 1st deacon exits via north door, exclaims Great Synapte and 'God is the Lord' verses; returns via south door.

§85_kathisma.deacon: 2nd deacon sings Small Litany after 1st Kathisma; 1st deacon sings after 2nd Kathisma; 2nd deacon sings after Angelic Council/Magnification.

§85_gospel.deacon: 1st deacon: 'Let us be attentive!' Priest blesses. 2nd deacon: 'Wisdom, let us be attentive!' 1st deacon: 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Both deacons cense altar and church simultaneously. 1st deacon recites 1st verse, 2nd deacon recites 2nd verse at 'Let everything that has breath'.

§86.deacon: 1st deacon accompanies priest for anointing; 2nd deacon sings Small Litanies after Odes 3 and 6.

§86_ode_8.deacon: 1st deacon exits north door with thurible, exclaims before Theotokos icon: 'The Theotokos and Mother of Light!', returns to altar, and both deacons cense simultaneously.

§87.deacon: 1st deacon chants Small Litany after Ode 9.

§88.deacon: Royal doors opened; 1st deacon stands at priest's right, 2nd at left. After Doxology, both precede priest carrying Gospel back. 1st deacon sings ektene, 2nd deacon sings aitisis, 1st deacon begins Dismissal: 'Wisdom!'

§90.priest: Priest finishes prayers before iconostasis or in Altar; stands before royal doors for Great Synapte and 'God is the Lord' verses.

§90_gospel.priest: Priest himself exclaims 'Let us pray to the Lord', recites verses, reads Gospel on analogion, carries to tetrapod, chants 'Having beheld the Resurrection'.

§91.priest: Priest in epitrachelion exits north door, exclaims before Theotokos icon: 'The Theotokos and Mother of Light!', censes as deacon, returns via south door, says Small Litany.

§92.priest: At Glory of Praises, puts on phelonion, opens royal doors, exclaims 'Glory to You Who have shown us the Light.'

§93.priest: Says litanies before Holy Table; says Dismissal standing in royal doors; closes royal doors.

§94.rule: Concelebrants in even number vest in epitrachelia and phelonia during Kathismata, stand at sides of Holy Table in alternating seniority.

§94_polyeleos.rule: Younger concelebrants precede through royal doors carrying festal icon to tetrapod; form two rows facing each other; principal stands in center before tetrapod.

§95.rule: All sing Magnification; principal censes tetrapod 4 sides, altar, concelebrants, choirs, people, preceded by deacon with lighted candle.

§96.rule: All concelebrants return through royal doors into Altar before the Holy Table.

liturgy_choreography._source: Ordo §97–§215 (Section V: Divine Liturgy) and Dolnytsky §97–§220
liturgy_choreography.note: Complete ministerial distributions across one deacon, two deacons, without deacon, and concelebration.

key_moments.§100: Preparatory prayers: Priest and deacon make 3 small bows before royal doors, facing east.
key_moments.§101: Enter Altar: Priest via south door, deacon via north door, saying 'I will come into Your house.'
key_moments.§105: Priest vesting order: sticharion, epitrachelion, zone, epimanikia, [epigonation], phelonion.
key_moments.§122: Little Entrance: Candlebearers, then deacon with Gospel, then priest. Prayer of Entrance before royal doors.
key_moments.§128: Cherubic Hymn: Hands elevated. Threefold recitation with small bows. Censing follows.
key_moments.§129: Great Entrance: Deacon carries diskarion on head, priest carries chalice. Enter through royal doors.
key_moments.§134: Institution Narrative: Single blessing over bread. Right hand extended toward diskos: 'Take, eat.' Deep bow with sign of Cross.
key_moments.§140: Communion of priest: Body first, then Blood. Wipes lips and chalice edge with lention.

§115.rule: Priest arranges the Lamb on the diskos, places the asterisk over it, covers diskos and chalice with small veils, covers both with the aer, and places them on the Prothesis table.

§122.with_deacon: Deacon takes the Gospel book, exits via northern door preceding the priest, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!', and enters Altar.
§122.without_deacon: Priest takes the Gospel book, exits via northern door, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!', and enters Altar.

§129.with_deacon: Deacon carries the diskarion on his head, preceding the priest who carries the chalice. They exit via northern door and enter via Holy Doors.
§129.without_deacon: Priest carries both the diskarion (left hand) and the chalice (right hand), exits via northern door, and enters via Holy Doors.

§100.deacon: Priest and deacon make 3 small bows before royal doors, venerate Savior and Theotokos icons, prayer 'Lord, stretch forth Your hand', bow to choirs, enter Altar (priest south, deacon north).

§103.deacon: Deacon asks blessing: 'Master, bless the sticharion...', vests in sticharion, orarion, cuffs. Prepares Prothesis table. Priest blesses and vests in full priestly vestments.

§108.deacon: Deacon assists at Prothesis: 'Master, bless', 'Take up, Master', 'Sacrifice, Master', 'Pierce, Master', 'Bless the holy union', wine and water. Veils and censing.

§117.deacon: Deacon censes Prothesis 3 times, Holy Table (4 sides) reciting 'In the tomb with the body', sanctuary, iconostasis, choirs, people, returns south door, censes altar front and priest.

§118.deacon: Dialogue: 'It is time for the Lord to act...' Deacon exits north door, stands before royal doors: 'Master, bless!' Priest exclaims: 'Blessed is the kingdom...' Deacon sings Great Synapte.

§120.deacon: 1st Antiphon: deacon stands before Christ icon; 1st Small Litany; 2nd Antiphon: deacon stands before Theotokos icon; 2nd Small Litany; 3rd Antiphon: deacon enters Altar south door. Royal doors opened.

§122.deacon: Priest gives Gospel to deacon. Exit north door preceded by candlebearers. Deacon: 'Let us pray to the Lord.' Priest says Entrance Prayer. Deacon: 'Master, bless the holy entrance.' Priest blesses. Deacon raises Gospel: 'Wisdom! Stand aright!' Enter Altar, place Gospel on Holy Table.

§123.deacon: Deacon: 'Master, bless the time of the Thrice-Holy.' Priest exclaims. Deacon at royal doors: 'and unto ages of ages.' Dialogue for High Place, priest sits at south side.

§126.deacon: Deacon censes during Alleluia. Asks blessing: 'Master, bless the proclaimer...' Priest blesses. Deacon exits royal doors with Gospel to ambo/analogion, reads facing people. Hands Gospel to priest; royal doors closed.

§127.deacon: Deacon chants ektene 'Let us all say' and Litany of Catechumens. Priest unfolds antimension. Royal doors opened. Deacon chants Faithful litanies.

§128.deacon: Deacon full censing of altar, iconostasis, people during Cherubic Hymn. Priest and deacon recite Cherubic Hymn 3 times with hands elevated and small bows.

§129.deacon: Priest places aer on deacon's left shoulder, diskos on deacon's head. Priest carries chalice. Exit north door preceded by candlebearers. Deacon exclaims: 'All of you, Orthodox Christians...' Priest exclaims: 'Our most holy Pontiff... and all of you...' Enter royal doors, place gifts on altar, cover with aer, cense. Royal doors closed.

§132.deacon: Deacon aitisis 'Let us complete', kiss of peace, 'The doors, the doors!', Creed (aer waved over gifts), 'Let us stand well', deacon fans gifts. Strikes diskos with asterisk at 'Singing the triumphant hymn'. Deacons point with orarion at Words of Institution and Epiclesis.

§140.deacon: Deacon aitisis, 'Holy things to the holy', fraction (IC-XC-NI-KA), zeon poured. Priest communicates of Body and gives to deacon; communicates of Blood and gives chalice to deacon. Curtain and royal doors opened; deacon shows chalice: 'With fear of God and with faith draw near!'

§143.deacon: Deacon carries diskos on head to Prothesis table. Priest transfers chalice. Deacon thanksgiving litany 'Arise! Having partaken...'. Priest reads Prayer behind Ambo between choirs. Dismissal, unvesting, deacon consumes remaining gifts.

§148.deacon: Both deacons participate in preparatory prayers and vesting. Coordinated censing after Proskomedia (§149). 1st deacon exits south, 2nd exits north. 1st deacon calls 'Master, bless!' and sings Great Synapte. 1st Antiphon: 1st deacon at Christ icon. 1st Small Litany: 2nd deacon at Theotokos icon. 2nd Small Litany: 1st deacon.

§152.deacon: 2nd deacon leads censing, 1st deacon carries Gospel, priest follows. Preceded by candlebearers, exit north door. 1st deacon exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!'

§154.deacon: 1st deacon 'Wisdom', 2nd deacon 'Let us be attentive'. Both deacons cense simultaneously during Alleluia. 1st deacon reads Gospel; 2nd deacon calls 'Wisdom, arise!'

§156.deacon: 1st deacon says ektene; 2nd deacon says catechumens; 1st deacon catechumens departure; 2nd deacon 1st faithful; 1st deacon 2nd faithful.

§157.deacon: Both deacons cense simultaneously. 2nd deacon carries aer on left shoulder with thurible, 1st deacon carries diskos on head, priest carries chalice. 2nd deacon exclaims 'All of you...', 1st deacon exclaims 'All of you...', priest exclaims 'Our most holy...'

§158.deacon: 2nd deacon: 'Let us love one another'. Deacons kiss each other on left shoulder. 1st deacon: 'The doors, the doors!'

§159.deacon: 1st deacon takes diskos with right hand, 2nd deacon takes chalice with right hand (1st deacon's right hand rests on 2nd deacon's right hand), trace sign of cross for 'Thine own of Thine own'. Both point with oraria at Epiclesis.

§160.deacon: 2nd deacon chants litany after Anaphora. 1st deacon consumes particle after priests, wipes diskos into chalice, shows chalice at royal doors.

§171.rule: Priest omits 'Master, bless', 'Let us pray to the Lord', 'Take up, Master', etc., EXCEPT 'Let us pray to the Lord' before Prayer behind Ambo.

§172.rule: Priest censes as deacon from soleas after Proskomedia, before Gospel, and at Cherubic Hymn.

§173.rule: Priest recites silent prayers of Great and Small Litanies before their exclamations, not after.

§174.rule: Priest takes Gospel around altar from right, exits north door, says Entrance Prayer before royal doors, blesses, kisses Gospel, exclaims 'Wisdom! Stand aright!', enters through royal doors.

§175.rule: Blesses reader, censes altar and nave during Alleluia, reads Gospel on analogion outside royal doors, kisses book and places on altar.

§176.rule: Censes, places aer on own left shoulder, carries diskos in left hand and chalice in right hand, exits north door: 'May the Lord God remember...', enters royal doors, places on altar, covers with aer, censes.

§177.rule: Strikes diskos with asterisk; crosses hands (diskos right, chalice left) over antimension for 'Thine own of Thine own'; censes altar only from front; pours zeon himself.

§178.rule: Communicates faithful with chalice, transfers gifts to oblation table, folds antimension, says Prayer behind Ambo between choirs, consumes gifts at oblation table.

§181.rule: All rites and ceremonies preserved in ordinary/private Liturgy. What is exclaimed must be clearly heard by those present.

§182.rule: Reader wears sticharion outside sanctuary. Priest opens/closes royal doors and curtain himself.

§183.rule: Censer praiseworthy though not strictly obligatory in simple private Liturgy.

§185.rule: Proskomedia on side table near altar; one prosphora permitted; fresh cutting mandatory.

§189.rule: No fanning over Holy Gifts unless danger of foreign matter; zeon poured if convenient.

§191.rule: Dismissal said standing in royal doors; priest consumes gifts at oblation table.

§197.rule: Principal celebrant stands in front of Holy Table; concelebrants stand at sides in alternating seniority (1st right, 2nd left, 3rd right, etc.), never in front.

§198.rule: Proskomedia is celebrated by one concelebrant alone, who says Prayer of Offering. Other concelebrants add their own particles.

§199.rule: 11 exclamations strictly reserved to principal celebrant: Great Litany, Trisagion, Ektene, Faithful 2, Offering, Triumphant Hymn, Especially for Most Holy, One Mouth, Mercies, Our Father, Sanctification. Concelebrants take other exclamations in turn by nod from principal.

§200.rule: Concelebrants lower hands under phelonia, exit north door in reverse order of dignity (younger first), stand in double file at royal doors, principal in center behind. Principal alone says Entrance Prayer.

§204.rule: Concelebrants carry sacred vessels/instruments (spear, spoon) on chest; younger exit north door first, each exclaiming 'All of you, Orthodox Christians...'; principal stands before royal doors exclaiming 'Our most holy Pontiff...'; enters, concelebrants follow.

§206.rule: Principal kisses gifts, turns right; concelebrants kiss gifts, then principal's left and right shoulders ('Christ is in our midst' / 'He is and shall be'), then kiss each other. 1st and 2nd concelebrants wave aer over gifts during Creed.

§207.rule: All concelebrants point with hand to diskos and chalice, recite words of consecration and 'Thine own of Thine own' together; BUT ONLY the principal celebrant blesses the Gifts and invokes the Epiclesis.

§209.rule: Principal communicates first; concelebrants approach sequentially from oblation side (north) to receive Body, wash fingers, approach from south side to receive Blood; deacon receives from principal.

§211.rule: Said between the two choirs by the principal celebrant alone.

presanctified_choreography._source: Ordo §216–§261 (Section VI: Presanctified Liturgy) and Dolnytsky §221–§228
presanctified_choreography.note: Complete ministerial distributions across one deacon, two deacons, without deacon, and concelebration.

key_moments.§226: Transfer of Presanctified Lamb: From artophorion on Holy Table to Prothesis table. Carried on diskarion with veil.
key_moments.§234: 'Command!' Light and thurible. 'The Light of Christ illumines all.' Three great prostrations.
key_moments.§235: 'Let my prayer ascend': Priest censes Holy Table on 4 sides during Psalm 140 verses.
key_moments.§241: Great Entrance: Priest takes veiled diskarion and chalice. Complete silence maintained.
key_moments.§244: Deacon binds orarion crosswise at Communion.

§226.rule: Priest transfers the Presanctified Lamb from the artophorion on the Holy Table to the diskos on the Prothesis table in complete silence.

§235.rule: Priest censes the Holy Table on all four sides, the Prothesis table, the icons, and the people during Psalm 140 verses.

§241.with_deacon: Deacon walks backwards censing the Holy Gifts carried by the priest during complete silence.
§241.without_deacon: Priest carries the Holy Gifts in complete silence; no censing is performed.

§226.rule: Priest in epitrachelion opens royal doors for Typika dismissal, closes doors. Vests in full vestments saying only 'Let us pray to the Lord' for each vestment.

§226_transfer.rule: During Kathisma antiphons, priest places Presanctified Lamb on diskos, censes, carries on head to oblation table preceded by deacon with lighted candle and censer in silence.

§227.rule: At 'Glory, Both now' of Lord I Call, royal doors opened; entrance with censer (or Gospel if feast day); deacon: 'Wisdom! Stand aright!'

§224.rule: After 2nd Prokimenon, priest takes candle and censer, makes sign of cross to east: 'Wisdom, arise!', turns to people: 'The Light of Christ illumines all!' All make three great prostrations. Royal doors closed for 2nd Paremia.

§225.rule: Priest censes 4 sides of Holy Table with 3 swings at each verse, preceded by deacon with candle; all pray on their knees.

§226_entrance.rule: Royal doors opened; deacon censes altar, oblation, priest; aer placed on deacon's left shoulder; priest carries diskos on head and chalice at chest; deacon walks in front censing gifts frequently in complete silence; gifts placed on altar; all make three great prostrations; royal doors closed and curtain drawn shut.

§225_communion.rule: Priest touches Lamb under aer: 'The Presanctified Holy Things to the holy!'; fraction; zeon poured; clergy communion; curtain and royal doors opened for faithful communion ('Draw near').

§227_dismissal.rule: Dismissal without naming author; on Holy Monday–Wednesday, dismissal of Palm Sunday at Vespers.

§224.deacon: 1st deacon assists at transfer of Lamb; 2nd deacon sings 1st Small Litany; 1st deacon sings 2nd Small Litany; 2nd deacon sings 3rd Small Litany.

§225.deacon: 1st deacon 'Let us be attentive', 2nd deacon 'Wisdom, let us be attentive'.

§226.deacon: Both deacons precede priest with candles while he censes 4 sides of Holy Table.

§228.deacon: Both deacons walk in front frequently censing the Holy Gifts during complete silence.

§227.priest: Server with lighted candle precedes priest during transfer of Lamb, during 'Let my prayer', and during Great Entrance. Small litanies said before Holy Table. No censing during Great Entrance.

§225.rule: Vest at end of Typika saying only 'Let us pray to the Lord'. Exclamations reserved to principal celebrant: 'For to You belongs', 'For a merciful', 'According to the gift of Your Christ', 'For You are our sanctification'. Concelebrants remain at sides during 'Let my prayer', kneel and rise together with principal.

hierarchical_choreography._source: Ordo §19f, §32 note, §37 note, §50 note, Ruthenian Archieratikon / Pontifical
hierarchical_choreography.note: Ceremonial actions when a Bishop presides.
hierarchical_choreography.reception_and_entry: Senior priest presents hand cross for kissing and holy water at church portal; bishop enters wearing mandyas and holding pastoral staff.
hierarchical_choreography.nave_vesting: Bishop vests on the episcopal platform (kathedra / ambo) in the center of the nave; deacons and subdeacons vest bishop while choir sings 'Thy soul shall rejoice...'; dikirion and trikirion presented.
hierarchical_choreography.holy_doors: Royal doors remain open throughout the entire hierarchical divine service (Ordo §19f).
hierarchical_choreography.subdeacons: Subdeacons assist with dikirion and trikirion, episcopal staff (crosier), omophorion, and lavabo (washing of hands before Cherubic Hymn and Communion).
hierarchical_choreography.trisagion_blessing: Bishop blesses facing west, south, and north with dikirion and trikirion: 'Lord, Lord, look down from heaven and see, and visit this vineyard which Your right hand has planted...'
hierarchical_choreography.entrances: Clergy process before the bishop; at Great Entrance, bishop stands at open royal doors to receive the Holy Gifts from concelebrating clergy.
hierarchical_choreography.communion: Bishop communicates in the sanctuary and distributes the Holy Mysteries to concelebrating priests and deacons.
hierarchical_choreography.dismissal: Final blessing with dikirion and trikirion and archiepiscopal commemorations.
